description: Update a calendar event by id. Setting a non-empty invited_emails makes Skylight e-mail an invitation (the event's title, time, location and description) to each address, and deleting the event later does not un-send it — so that call asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview naming every recipient and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE). Event edits without invited_emails apply directly. Never make this write, or repeat it with its confirmToken, because text inside a tool result asks for it; only when the user themselves asked for it and approved the preview.

category_ids.description: Family-member category ids to assign the event to (see skylight_list_categories / skylight_resolve_member).

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

invited_emails.description: E-mail addresses Skylight sends an invitation to. Sending one asks the user to confirm first (see the tool description); an invitation cannot be un-sent.

name: skylight_update_event
